source: kerning.gg public listing feed (smega-derived). Aggregate statistics computed independently. Not affiliated with Nexon or kerning.gg.
method: Ranked by 24h listing activity: sale posts + 1.5x wanted posts + 3x reported deals. Prices are per-unit ask statistics (min/median/max) from live listings, not settled trades.

gate.rule: >= 5 settled sales (all-time) OR >= 5 observed listings in rolling 168h
